title: The Method Comes Last
scopeNote: This keeps the cascade: declare a starting point, then make decisions whose options are never labelled with the position they belong to. Three of the five decisions and the second pass from another starting point are cut; once a learner has run the cascade the comparison can be shown rather than performed, which is what step three does.
summary: One fictional school and three starting points. Declare what you take disruption to be, make two decisions, and watch a study assemble itself that can answer one question and not the others.
learningObjectives: Say what each of three epistemologies takes its research object to be.
Explain why the method follows from the object rather than the reverse.
Say what each completed study could and could not claim about the same case.
Recognise that being in tension with a declared position is not the same as being forbidden.
Name the fourth position that locates the problem inside individuals.
interactionTypes: a judgement about what decides a method
a declared starting point that opens the decisions
two design decisions whose options are unlabelled
live annotation of what each choice commits you to
a three-way comparison of what each completed study could and could not say
privacy: Nothing is collected, stored or transmitted.
dataStatus: Meadowbank Academy is invented. No real school, policy, dataset or document is described and every figure was written for teaching.
accessibilityNotes: Keyboard operable throughout. The starting point is a group of native radio buttons in a labelled fieldset, and each design decision is a group of buttons carrying three non-colour state signals plus a visually hidden sentence naming the state. A chosen option states in words whether it follows from the declaration or sits in tension with it, so nothing depends on colour. The three completed studies are compared in a real table with row and column headers. Nothing is timed and there is no motion.
simulationNotes: Coherence is the count of decisions whose home position matches the declared one. That is deliberately a weak model and the page says so twice: it is the minimum a design has to clear rather than a measure of quality, and a perfectly coherent study can still be a bad one. The teaching is carried by the prose attached to each option, which is why every option holds both what it commits you to and what tension it creates under another position, and why a non-matching choice is marked partial rather than incorrect. Option order is rotated per decision. The original always lists options in the order measure, mechanism, construct, individual, so the matching option sits at the same index every time, which over two decisions is a positional tell a learner can follow without reading; each decision here applies a fixed rotation and the test suite checks that no position occupies the same index in both, and that the matching option is neither the longest nor the shortest in both. The fourth position, which relocates the problem inside a minority of pupils, is named in the comparison rather than scored against, because it is the design a school is most likely to fund and students should be able to recognise it. Three positions is a simplification of a contested landscape and the page does not rank them.
readmeTopic: why the decision that shapes a study most is the one taken before it starts
